title: pm-dispatch: one seat record per governed PR; the card keeps a pointer; the landing comment is the probe table; the director ledger is one block per summon
body:
Fixes #23381
Clause-②: no

Text-only charter change on four pm-dispatch files, under the maintainer's 「同意」 (2026-10-14, chat) on the director seat's proposal, quoted verbatim on the card: 「席位产物合并。ACCEPT 和速读终稿合成 PR 上一条记录,卡上只留指针;落地记录保持探针表;台账只在每场收工写一块。」 and 「立卡你决定,不需要我同意」. Dispatched by the `domain:skills` seat (claim comment 6163070718); the dev leaves no claim of its own. Base `b5b1bf7277` = `origin/main` at dispatch; head `a19252d363`.

Cards named here with no closing verb beside them: #23379 and #23380 (landed as b5b1bf7277 and 5656c5638a — out of scope here), #23352, #23389, #23396, #23405 (in flight; their files are not touched here), #23414 (landed — out of scope here).

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:席位在每张受管 PR 上只写一条记录。Tier H 的 PR 把五段「维护者速读」放在最上面,下面紧跟 `## 席位核对`(形态 / 前提实测 / 门禁 check-runs / 接受的偏差 / 范围外去向 / 落地条款);Tier S 的 PR 只有 `## 席位核对`。卡上只留一行指针,指向 PR 上那条评论。落地时卡上的评论只剩两个读数的探针表加一行状态变更,不再复述 ACCEPT。总监席的摘要台账每场收工写一块,不再每落地一张写一块。四个文件、十五行改动,没有代码、脚本或门禁改动。

**为什么改**:您在 2026-10-14 同意了总监席的方案 6。今天每张卡落地要留五到六段席位散文(认领、dev 报告、卡上的 ACCEPT、PR 上的速读终稿、落地记录、台账块),ACCEPT 的内容在终稿和台账里各被复述一遍。您只读 PR 上的速读;席位需要的是门禁并集、偏差和落地条款,不是散文。合成一条记录后,您读的东西不变,席位少写三段,卡上少一段大评论。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:机器读的东西一样没动——合并队列守卫和落地前检读的是 PR 上的 `## Contract review` 记录,不是席位的 ACCEPT 段落(`record-recognisers.mjs` 的自测把席位 ACCEPT 段落钉为「不是记录」,本 PR 的 head 上该自测 312 例全过)。代价是三处本 PR 不能碰的旧句子会过时(`execution-duties.md:179` 的「issue 英文短评论」,两个脚本里打印的「ACCEPT on the card」补救文案),已在下方 Acceptance notes 点名,由持有那些文件的在飞 PR 承接。另有一个未实测的平台读数:`platform-readings.md:426` 记的「ACCEPT 照过」没有说明是在卡上还是 PR 上测的,而新形态把 ACCEPT 写到 PR 线程——首次落地时席位需要实测一次。回滚 = revert 这一个 commit,四个文件回到 `b5b1bf7277` 的字节。

**席位意见**:(留空,由席位填写)

**你要做的(一个动作)**:读完速读后,若同意,批准(或直接合并)这张 draft PR;`.claude/**` 按登记表是 Tier S,席位会按 `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr` 的读数走对应的落地路。

## What changed, line by line

Every edited or deleted line, before and after. Line numbers are the file's at `b5b1bf7277` (before) and at `a19252d363` (after). Placeholder note: the file spells the comment-id placeholder in angle brackets (`comment` followed by `id` in angle brackets); it is written as `comment ID` below because GitHub strips the angle-bracket form from bodies.

### `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 〈路径分叉〉 — 319 → 319 lines

The dispatch named the surface as L187–193; on `b5b1bf7277` the ① line is L188 (L187 is the 3000-line (`改动 over 3000 行`) rule, untouched). Six lines (L188–193) became seven (L188–194); the seventh is paid by deleting old L202, the queued pull-back line, whose content is AGENTS.md Prime Directive #14 「Already armed or queued when you read this? Disable auto-merge AND convert it back to draft … ask the maintainer at once to remove a queued PR by hand — then confirm from the remote …」 (plus `references/platform-readings.md:44` 「出队按队列 ref 阳性探针答不在队向」). AGENTS.md outranks this skill, so nothing is lost.

Before (L188–193):

```text
- ① 复核结论照常写在 issue 上;技能面 hunk 须由契约复审档的席复核,档外席先交 skills 席。
- ② PR 留给维护者看得见地悬着;终局两条:人工直合即审核记录;授权批准 ⇒ 席位落地。
- 看得见 = ACCEPT 同笔挂 `needs-user-decision` + 贴终稿「维护者速读」评论;①仍是审核记录。
- 速读五段固定:改了什么/为什么改/风险与代价(含回滚)/席位意见/你要做的(一个动作)。
- 草稿归 dev:受管面 PR 正文带 `## 维护者速读(草稿)`,中文、业务角度,席位意见留空。
- 终稿 = 席位对照自己读的 diff 校正草稿、填席位意见后贴评论;维护者只读评论。
```

After (L188–194; the 速读五段 and 草稿归 dev lines are byte-identical):

```text
- ① 席位记录一条落 PR,两层同欠:Tier H 置顶速读五段,其下 `## 席位核对`;卡只留指针行。
- ② PR 悬着等人批,同笔挂 `needs-user-decision`;人工直合即审核记录,授权批准 ⇒ 席位落地。
- 指针 `ACCEPT → PR #n comment ID`;技能面 hunk 须由契约复审档的席复核,档外席先交 skills 席。
- 核对六项(席位读此):形态/前提实测/门禁 check-runs/接受的偏差/范围外去向/落地条款。
- 速读五段固定:改了什么/为什么改/风险与代价(含回滚)/席位意见/你要做的(一个动作)。
- 草稿归 dev:受管面 PR 正文带 `## 维护者速读(草稿)`,中文、业务角度,席位意见留空。
- 终稿 = 席位对照自己读的 diff 校正草稿、填席位意见,置顶席位记录;维护者只读评论。
```

Deleted (old L202), paid for the seventh line above:

```text
- 已入队 ⇒ 转 draft 并 disable,即请维护者手动出队(席位无实测手段);出队以阳性探针答。
```

What each change carries: ① is the merged record (change 1 of the card) — one seat record on the PR, owed by both tiers, 速读 on top for Tier H, `## 席位核对` below, the card keeps a pointer line. ② keeps its two terminals and absorbs the label clause that the deleted 看得见 line carried (`needs-user-decision` is applied in the same stroke as the record). The 指针 line spells the pointer and keeps ①'s second clause (skills-face hunks are reviewed at the contract-review tier; an off-tier seat hands to the skills seat) unchanged. The 核对六项 line names the six items of `## 席位核对` and says seats read that section. The 终稿 line now places the corrected 速读 at the top of the seat record instead of a separate comment. Dropped without a home needed: 「复核结论照常写在 issue 上」 (no longer true), 「贴终稿「维护者速读」评论」 (replaced by the one record), 「①仍是审核记录」 (① now names the record itself). Untouched by the card's fence: L95, L108, the four-axis block L241–261 (md5 `abff5f852c8fd09b79ec0623439aa4f0` before and after).

### `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/landing-operations.md` — 101 → 101 lines

Inserted after L55 (「确认 MERGED 要两个读数:每轮同时读队列分支与 `origin/main`。」), change 2 of the card:

```text
- 落地评论 = 两个读数的探针表 + 一行状态变更(摘标/关卡/收口),⛔ 不复述 `## 席位核对`。
```

Deleted (old L57), to pay for it:

```text
- 窗口自身权责不变:跟到 MERGED、踢出处置、落地后对账。
```

Its three duties are each stated in the same file already: 跟到 MERGED — section B's heading 「跟到 MERGED 为止;入队后的看护归车道 PM 落地窗口」 and L49 「车道 PM 的权责三件:验收(复核清单)、首次入队、确认 MERGED」; 踢出处置 — L27 「红/踢出处置在同一落地窗口内做」; 落地后对账 — L73 「每次合并后重拉一次车道盘点与预期状态对账,⛔ 不留给下轮巡检」. The rider added no duty the section lacked. Re-read for truth, unchanged: L3 and L50 (ACCEPT as the event that opens the window), L15 (the dispatching seat's ACCEPT confirms a text-only DELIBERATE CORRECTION — a content rule that holds wherever the ACCEPT is written), L26 (落地记账 on the seat post — the execution seat's own list; the card's change 3 is the director's summon ledger, a different ledger).

### `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/director.md` — 65 → 66 lines (ceiling 72)

Inserted after L36 (「到合并 = 推进到就绪并点名等待,⛔ 不代维护者合并。」) in 职责一, change 3 of the card:

```text
- 摘要台账每场收工一块,⛔ 不逐落地写块;一次落地的记录 = PR 席位记录 + 落地探针表。
```

It does not restate SKILL.md L236 「一条裁决已记录的权威载体 = 总监席每场收工的摘要台账(卡、权威、方向、状态转移)」 — the four items stay there; this line adds only the cadence (one block per summon end, never one per landing) and what a landing's record is.

### `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md` L33 — 96 → 96 lines

Before:

```text
- 写侧刷新点 = 轮次边界;中途状态由卡上 claim/ACCEPT 评论承载。
```

After:

```text
- 写侧刷新点 = 轮次边界;中途状态由卡上 claim 评论与指针行、PR 上 `## 席位核对` 承载。
```

Nothing this PR changes is read by it.
